name: AIJ UWE — cleaned data API
description: Static JSON/CSV/STL endpoints for the Architectural Institute of Japan Urban Wind Environment benchmark (Cases A-M) and Eddy3D's validation against it. Every file is a plain HTTP GET; nothing is computed on request.
fallback_note: the same files, served raw from the repository at the tag v3.11.3, which never moves (use when the Pages site is not reachable)
compatibility: Semantic versioning, twice. `versions.release` versions what is served (MAJOR: a file, field or column renamed or removed, or a unit or frame changed; MINOR: something added; PATCH: a value corrected). Every release is also a frozen copy of the whole API under `/api/<release>/` whose files never change (`release_base_url`; all releases in versions.json), and the unversioned /api/ paths always equal the newest release: pin an analysis to a release by using that release's base URL. `schema_version` versions this JSON contract: within a major version it only adds new fields, endpoints and runs, clients must ignore fields they do not know, and a field is renamed or removed only in a new major version, which the changelog names. `data_version` is a fingerprint: the SHA-256 of the served data.
caching: GitHub Pages sends JSON with a 10-minute max-age and CSV and ZIP files with a 186-day max-age. Every download URL therefore carries ?v=<first 12 hex digits of the file's SHA-256>: the server ignores the query, and a changed file gets a new URL. Fetch the JSON documents for the current URLs; check downloads against `sha256`.

changes: Added to cases/{id}/validation.json: `grid_study`, the grid-convergence study of the OpenFOAM fixture (Cases A and E; null elsewhere): four meshes with every cell edge shrinking by sqrt(2), the scores on each mesh, the method (Roache's grid convergence index by the Celik et al. 2008 procedure, computed by foamgci), and `bands`, cases/{id}/grid/openfoam12-realizableKE.csv: per point the measured value, the value on the second mesh (cell scale 1.00) and that mesh's band. The study ran the fixture with the eddy-viscosity cap lifted, so its values are its own, not the served run's.

Added: cases/{id}/probes.csv, the published points to probe, one row per measured row of the point table: the key columns a scored file carries (point_id, config, campaign, instrument, run, wind_direction_deg), x y z in the case frame, and `scored_as`, the families the row is scored in (vector, k, thermistor_bracket, concentration, theta). Linked from cases/{id}.json `probes`.

Added to cases/{id}.json: `scoring` (the reference speed the measured side is divided by, the constants of theta, the conventions and the metric meanings: what validation/score_submissions.py scores with) and `inflow` (the benchmark's approach-flow data and fit under `benchmark_data`; the inlet this repository RECOMMENDS under `recommended`, a log law from the fit with k and epsilon from the neutral ABL relations, or the tabulated profile where no log law fits; the flow-direction convention; what Eddy3D's runs used, quoted from their snapshots).

Added: submissions.json and submissions/{slug}.json, the community results: every folder under submissions/ in the repository, scored in this build by validation/score_submissions.py (run it from a checkout to score your own), with each submission's own values at the published points served as submissions/{slug}/{id}.csv. A submission names its `solver` as free text (a slug); Eddy3D's engines keep the `engine` enum and the validation documents. The repository's own example (`example: true`) is served like any other and marked.

Added: cases/{id}/inflow_openfoam.txt, the recommended inlet as OpenFOAM 12 files in one text: 0/U, 0/k and 0/epsilon (atmBoundaryLayerInlet* where a log law fits, fixedProfile tables where not), 0/nut with the nutkAtmRoughWallFunction ground patch, and system/probes, a probes function object with the case's published points.
Changed: index.json `license_detail` says what the licence covers: the data CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA), the code MIT (LICENSE).

Added to index.json: `cite.api`, the citation of the API release (`title`, `version`, `url`, `release_url`, `doi`, `apa`, `bibtex`, `csl_json`). `url` is the pinned address of the release, `/api/<release>/index.json`; `doi` is null until Zenodo mints one for the release.
Added to cases/{id}.json: `citation`, the Zenodo dataset of the case as `apa` and `bibtex`.

Added to the `stats` of geometry.json and to the entries of the geometry index: `bodies`, `body_contacts`, `inconsistent_triangles` and `min_body_volume`, beside `edges_boundary`. `watertight` is true when every body is closed, consistently wound and positive in volume.

Changed: the `geometry.stl` of Cases E, F and M. Every body is a closed, consistently wound, outward body; Cases F and M stand on a 1 m base slab, so the bounding box of each starts at z = -1 m, and `triangles` and `data_version` change with the files.

Added: the layout figure of each case, `case-<id>-layout.png`, is the first entry of `figures` of the validation results of that case (Cases A to M); the agreement figures colour their points by the groups of that figure.

Added: release-numbered paths. Every release is a frozen copy of the whole API under `/api/<release>/` (for example `/api/3.0.0/index.json`, `/api/3.0.0/cases/F.json`). Every URL to a file of the API inside a copy points into the same copy (versions.json, served only at the unversioned path, aside), so a client that starts there never leaves it, and nothing under it changes once the release is tagged. The unversioned `/api/` paths are unchanged and always equal the newest release (the `latest` alias).

Added: `/api/versions.json` (schema `versions`), the list of every release, newest first: version, date, status (`latest` or `superseded`), schema_version, data_version, base_url, tag, release page and changelog. Release 2.0.0 predates the layout and is not regenerated: `/api/2.0.0/` holds the files of its tag byte for byte, with only their own addresses rewritten into the copy (scripts/host_release.py derives it and the release check re-derives it).

Added to index.json: `tree` (`release` in a frozen copy, `latest` in the alias), `release_base_url` (the frozen copy of `versions.release`; equal to `base_url` inside that copy) and `versions_url`. In a frozen copy `base_url` and `fallback_base_url` name that copy, and `release.base_url` (the raw files at the release tag) now ends in the release number; paths below it are unchanged.

Added: Cases F to M, thirteen cases in all (the `case_ids` of index.json): their cases.json entries, `cases/{id}.json`, points, approach flow, geometry (STL) and validation documents, and `pairs` files for the runs that exist. Every case has at least one scored run; an engine that has none for a case is `pending` there. `cases.json` and `validation.json` list thirteen cases (the schemas fixed the length at five).

Added: the point table's columns of schema 2.0.0 (the cleaned release) are served in `points.json` and `points.csv`: `campaign` and `run`, `uv` `uw` `vw`, `C` `c_rms` `concentration_ratio`, `T` `T_rms`, `uc` `vc` `wc`, `uT` `vT` `wT`, `velocity_ratio_sd` and `k_ratio`; `instrument` takes the new values `cup_anemometer`, `sonic_anemometer`, `ldv`, `hydrocarbon_analyser` and `sorbent_gc_ecd`. A document lists only the columns a case has.

Added: four engines, `openfoam12-kEpsilon` and `openfoam12-kOmegaSST`, which exist for Case I only (the closures other than realizable k-epsilon, solved on one mesh), and `umf-realizableKE` and `umf-buoyantKEpsilon`, Eddy3D's buoyant microclimate engine (urbanMicroclimateFoam, an OpenFOAM 12 solver) under its two closures, which exist for Cases J and L (`umf-buoyantKEpsilon` for J only). `engines` in `cases.json` and `cases/{id}.json` lists an engine only for the cases it applies to.

Added to each result of validation.json: `notes`, a list of the caveats that come with the run (what the model leaves out, what the measurement cannot say, how the solve ended); empty where the run has none recorded. Cases F, G and M have several runs on one engine (Case F: one per vertical frame, Case G: one per arm of a drag sweep, Case M: one per turbulent Schmidt number, each as `configuration`), all sharing the engine's pairs file; the first column of Case F's and Case G's names the frame or the arm, and Case M's holds the three Schmidt numbers as columns.

Added: `versions.release`, the semantic version of the published data and API (the repository's VERSION; tag vX.Y.Z; rules in CHANGELOG.md), and `release` with its date, tag, release page and `base_url`, the raw files of exactly that release (the tag never moves). `schema_version` stays the version of this JSON contract.

Correction: index.json gave each templated endpoint (cases/{id}.json, schemas/{name}.schema.json, ...) its URI template under `url`, which is not a URL and answered 404 when followed. A templated endpoint now says `templated: true` and lists every concrete file under `urls`; `url` is given only for single-file endpoints, and no URL anywhere contains a brace. llms.txt lists the concrete files the same way.
Breaking: cases/{id}.json `gotchas` is renamed `known_issues`.
Breaking: `licence` is replaced by `license`, the SPDX identifier CC-BY-4.0; index.json `licence_detail` is `license_detail`.

Breaking: `generated_from` and `generated_at` are removed. `data_version`, a SHA-256 over every served measurement, geometry and score file, changes when, and only when, the data does; the build is reproducible byte for byte.

Breaking: links to JSON resources are named `url` (was `file`, `endpoint`, `endpoint_json`); file downloads are objects with `url`, `path`, `media_type`, `bytes` and `sha256` (points `csv`, approach-flow `csv`, run `pairs`, geometry files, the archive, and every entry of index.json `files`).
Breaking: a validation result's `figures` is a list of {url, caption}.
Added: validation.json, every case and engine in one table with each run's headline scores.
Added: cases/{id}/pairs/{engine}.csv, the per-point measured and modelled values behind every scored run, so any score can be recomputed; linked from each result as `pairs`.
Added: cases/{id}/approach_flow.csv, the measured approach-flow profile in SI units.
Added: schemas/{name}.schema.json, the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of every document, named by its `$schema` and embedded in openapi.json.
Added: `run_id` on every validation result; geometry renders and captions in geometry.json.
Added: download URLs carry `?v=<SHA-256 prefix>`, so a changed file has a new URL and no cache serves a stale copy.
Added: /llms.txt at the site root, and schema.org Dataset metadata on the home page.
First release.

endpoints.description: every endpoint and file with its size and SHA-256, versions, compatibility policy, changelog, licence, how to cite the API (cite.api)
every release, newest first: version, date, status (latest or superseded), schema and data version, base URL, tag, changelog; always at the unversioned /api/ path
every case: id, title, frame, units, counts, engine status, links

one case in full: configurations, frame, units, inflow fit and approach-flow profile, point-table summary, geometry files, validation status, known data issues, attribution, citation of the case's dataset
the cleaned measurement table: SI units, one frame, null where not measured
the same table as CSV (empty cell = not measured)
the measured approach-flow profile: z (m), U (m/s), and k (m^2/s^2) or u_rms (m/s) where published; Case G's U and k are dimensionless (U/Ub, k/Ub^2)
the case's STL files with statistics, renders, and the boxes where the geometry is boxes
cleaned ASCII STL of the default configuration: metres, case frame, outward normals
the other configurations' STLs (C: 0D, 1D; E: bc, before construction)
the published points to probe for a comparison: the key columns of a scored file, x y z in the case frame, and what each row is scored as

the recommended inlet as OpenFOAM 12 files in one text (0/U, 0/k, 0/epsilon, 0/nut, system/probes with the case's points); the benchmark's data is the measured profile, the inlet is this repository's choice
Eddy3D's scores per engine and run, with figures and the per-point pairs
per-point measured and modelled values of one engine's runs on the case (columns described by the result's pairs_columns)
every case and engine in one table: status, runs, headline scores
every STL of every case in one list: case, configuration, units, frame, bounding box, size, SHA-256
every STL in one archive (each keeps its own case's frame and units: they are not one scene)
the community results: every submitted solver with its headline scores per case, scored by this build from the submitted values
one submission in full: its submission.yaml, and every score, coverage and group per case
the values a submission gave at the published points of one case (the key columns of probes.csv plus its value columns)
the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of each JSON document
OpenAPI 3.1 description of every endpoint
plain-text entry point for agents

agents.pin_a_version: GET https://aij.eddy3d.com/api/versions.json and use the base_url of the release you want; paths are the same in every release
walk: GET cases.json and pick an id
GET cases/{id}.json for frame, units and known_issues
GET cases/{id}/points.json (SI units, one frame) and cases/{id}/geometry.stl (metres)
GET validation.json or cases/{id}/validation.json before quoting any Eddy3D score; an engine that is not 'scored' has no result
GET cases/{id}/probes.csv, cases/{id}/inflow_openfoam.txt and cases/{id}.json scoring and inflow to score your own solver (python validation/score_submissions.py, from a checkout)
GET submissions.json for the community results (submitted values, scored by this repository's build)
